title: exudyn.symbolic: a cross product of symbolic vectors
author: Claude-JG
description: Found in the analysis of #3069: exudyn.symbolic.Vector has no cross product; a user function writes the components out or uses exudyn.symbolicUtilities.Cross. Add Vector.cross / a function Cross for symbolic vectors of length 3, recorded as one operation.
releaseNotes: exudyn.symbolic.cross(a, b): the cross product of two vectors of 3 components, symbolic or one of them a list or numpy array, as numpy.cross; recorded.
